## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Refactoring / Code Quality Improvement

- [ ] CI/CD or Build Infrastructure

## Pre-Merge Verification Checklist

- [ ] Code compiles cleanly without errors (`python -m py_compile ...`).
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets, API keys, passwords, or personal credentials are included.
- [ ] Environment variable changes are reflected in `.env.example`.
- [ ] Documentation (`README.md`, `docs/*`) has been updated if applicable.
- [ ] No breaking changes to database schemas or application APIs without documentation.
